People forget that index funds weren't cheap when they launched, even Vgrd's, nearly 50bps. But over the years the structure lowered the fees, once they got to below 20bps the flows got big and when they got below 10bps, game over (such a good deal many brokers left their firms to start RIAs just so they could buy Vanguard). This chart of Vgrd forcing itself to get cheap is effectivtly the Crucible that the entire asset mgt industry has to go through (inside ETF terrordome) if it wants organic flows (ex hot sauce which live outside this vortex, hence all the launches). Smart beta went through it and now active is going through it. This is why the Bogle Effect is much, much greater than \"the index fund\" IMO.
